scaleNormalization.method: Detached the armature from the Sketchfab/FBX empty hierarchy, preserved world transforms, normalized local vertex span to 1.8, then applied armature and mesh transforms in Blender.

modificationRecord.result: No mesh, rig, bind pose, material, texture, clip, scale, or source file was modified. Production guide.glb export is deliberately deferred.

Removed the inherited 0.01 runtime scale by baking a 1.8-unit normalization into the armature and mesh; preserved the 58-joint bind rig and single primitive; baked the approved graphite/release-blue base-color edits; resized all maps to 1024px WebP; added lossless EXT_meshopt_compression without position quantization. No geometry, gesture pose, or bone names were authored. Three.js runtime removes colons from node names via PropertyBinding.sanitizeNodeName; raw GLB names in this manifest remain unchanged.
